adaptations.__main__.py: Route package entry to the Public-owned launcher.
adaptations.app.py: Inject isolated Public runtime, credentials, service paths and instance endpoint; support user-owned tunnel configuration. Admit exclusive voluntary Public update handoff and expose active work.
adaptations.config.py: Require explicit instance-bound Public settings instead of private default paths and configuration.
adaptations.desktop.py: Route desktop entry to the Public-owned launcher.
adaptations.mcp.py: Use instance-scoped MCP credentials and active endpoint for source links.
adaptations.mcp_client.py: Resolve the selected Public instance and its credentials for the stdio bridge.
adaptations.providers.py: Use only the Public instance secret store; remove private installation key-file access.
adaptations.reminders.py: Use the instance notification adapter and endpoint for reminder links.
adaptations.runtime.py: Keep process waiting in the shared core; route lifecycle management through the Public runtime.
adaptations.speech.py: Use Public-managed speech model paths and installation callback.
adaptations.templates/base.html: Include the Public onboarding interface. Include voluntary Public update notice.
adaptations.templates/macros.html: Replace personal WSL defaults with user-supplied connection fields.
adaptations.templates/model.html: Require explicit confirmation when configuring a new non-loopback model service.
adaptations.templates/settings.html: Expose Public setup, credential storage status, migration notice and user-owned tunnel configuration. Expose voluntary program updates.
adaptations.tunnel.py: Use user-configured tunnel identity and isolated stores; avoid inspecting other applications processes.

additions.static/public_setup.js: Support the Public setup and credential controls.
additions.templates/public_setup.html: Provide the Public optional component setup page.
additions.static/public-updates.js: Control opt-in release checks, download and confirmed installation.
